In the general population, some studies have shown that among patients with anemia, approximately 1% to 2% is due to B12 deficiency.
Other studies have shown that among patients with clinical macrocytosis (defined as a mean corpuscular volume, MCV, >100), 18% to 20% were due to B12 deficiency.
B12 deficiency due to pernicious anemia is more common in people of Northern European ancestry.
The incidence of pernicious anemia is lower in people of African descent or people from other areas of Europe.[4][5]
